dialect.detail: Cobol-on-Wheelchair (COW) web framework - a CGI/web framework written in GnuCOBOL. Uses FUNCTION SUBSTITUTE, FUNCTION CONCATENATE, ACCEPT FROM ENVIRONMENT, COMP-5, and line-sequential files typical of GnuCOBOL. Multiple nested programs in a single source file.

purpose.domain_detail: CGI web framework for COBOL - routes HTTP requests based on URL path patterns, substitutes template variables in HTML view files
purpose.summary: This is the 'Cobol-on-Wheelchair' (COW) web framework. The main program reads the HTTP PATH_INFO query, matches it against routing patterns, dispatches to handler subprograms, and supports a templating engine that substitutes {{varname}} placeholders in HTML view files. It includes subprograms for query parsing, pattern matching, variable display, template rendering, and file status checking.

notable_features: Multiple nested programs in single source file (END PROGRAM markers)
CGI web framework pattern (content-type header output, PATH_INFO parsing)
FUNCTION SUBSTITUTE for template variable substitution
ACCEPT FROM ENVIRONMENT for CGI environment variables
Line sequential file I/O for template reading
Routing table with pattern matching using % prefix for variable capture
verdict.notes: This is the well-known open-source 'Cobol-on-Wheelchair' CGI web framework. The file contains 6 nested programs: cow (main dispatcher), getquery, showvars, checkquery, cowtemplate, and checkfilestatus. The cowtemplate program is nested inside itself structurally (checkfilestatus is nested within cowtemplate). The framework is designed to run as a CGI program under Apache or similar web servers.
